The mugs overlap in the camera view; an independently visible endpoint for the second mug cannot be established when her hand withdraws. Occlusion prevents a confident disappearance finding.",
    "01:18–01:26 — White mugs: visible near the pair as the waitress moves around to sit beside the customer; the wide view does not establish continuous individual mug identity.",
    "01:27–01:35 — Two white mugs: one held by the seated waitress and one by the customer, both at counter level; each remains with its respective holder throughout this shot.",
    "01:37–01:40 — White mug in payment close-up: stationary on the counter behind the banknotes; no hand moves it.",
    "01:38–01:40 — Folded banknotes: pressed onto the counter by the screen-left hand and contacted by the screen-right hand; both hands withdraw, leaving the notes beside the mug. The top note curls upward; overlapping lower notes prevent a reliable individual count.",
    "01:50–01:53 — Two white drinking vessels: visible on the counter near the seated waitress; she rises and gathers them at 01:51, then carries them toward the rear work area. Her body obscures the final set-down.",
